title: ssh-keygen creates a new key pair in a fake home
threat_model: No attacker. A user generates a new ed25519 key pair with ssh-keygen in their own .ssh directory.
notes: The action creates the .ssh directory in a fake home directly under /home and runs ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 with an empty passphrase and -f into it. There is no network. Predicted: no alert. The kernel filter reports opens under .ssh, and sensitive_file_access skips a tier 1 open by a comm in EXPECTED_READERS, which includes ssh-keygen. The names written are not authorized_keys, so persistence_write does not match them.
